lookedFor: robots.txt of lovable.dev, read 2026-10-12 at 19:02 UTC: /login is not disallowed.

The provider's Terms, last updated 2026-08-28 and effective 2026-08-15, License Restrictions. Fragment as returned by the fetch tool: "use automated tools (such as bots, scrapers, or crawlers) to access or interact with the Services without our"; the tool gave the continuation as "written permission;". The page was therefore not rendered and no capture exists. The Platform Rules and other documents the terms refer to were not part of what the tool read.
This repository's review notes: an earlier static read returned a login title with a loading shell, judged insufficient for selector or identity-provider assumptions. No markup.

A web search for how sign-in works: the results quote the provider's documentation as listing email and password, Google, GitHub and Apple, and single sign-on for business plans. So a password form is described, but nothing found shows it. The documentation pages were not fetched, because the terms cover the Services.

KeePassXC-Browser's site list (commit 8b0b2c4) has no entry for this site. Chromium's public password-manager site tests (commit 88f1fe85) hold no recipes. Mozilla's published password recipes (13 records, read 2026-10-12) have no entry for this sign-in.
neededFromUser: In your own browser, signed out: open https://lovable.dev/login and save the sign-in page. If the password is asked on a second page, save that one too before typing the password. Note the address of each up to the question mark. Save each as Webpage, Complete (HTML only re-downloads the address and misses a scripted or submitted form). Keep the files outside the repository: they can hold your account name. Import: node scripts/capture-login-page.mjs --id lovable --from-file <file.html>
